steps.phase: Read the frozen brief and surface assumptions
steps.title: Preserve the exact frozen problem brief
steps.content: FROZEN BRIEF — ID: mlops_008. Title: ‘Design a Data Labeling and Annotation Platform’. Slug: ‘design-a-data-labeling-and-annotation-platform’. Description: ‘Design a data labeling platform that supports image, text, and audio annotation, manages labeling workflows, ensures label quality, and provides active learning-based sample selection.’ Difficulty: Medium. Category: MLOps - Data Labeling. Domain: aiml. Estimated time: 45-60 minutes. Requirements: ‘Support image bounding box, polygon, and segmentation annotations’; ‘Handle text classification, NER, and relation labeling’; ‘Manage labeling task assignment and workflows’; ‘Implement inter-annotator agreement metrics’; ‘Provide pre-labeling with model-assisted suggestions’; ‘Support consensus labeling and adjudication’; ‘Integrate with ML training pipelines’; ‘Track labeling throughput and quality metrics’. Constraints: ‘Support 100+ concurrent annotators’; ‘Inter-annotator agreement (Kappa) above 0.8’; ‘Handle datasets with 1M+ items’; ‘Annotation interface latency under 100ms’; ‘Export labels in standard formats (COCO, VOC)’. Hints: ‘Use Label Studio or CVAT as open-source base’; ‘Implement active learning for intelligent sample selection’; ‘Use pre-trained models for label suggestions’; ‘Implement quality control with gold standard questions’; ‘Use webhooks for pipeline integration’; ‘Implement annotation versioning for dataset iterations’. Tags: mlops, data-labeling, annotation, active-learning, data-quality, crowdsourcing. Companies: Scale AI, Labelbox, Appen, Amazon (MTurk). The hints are candidate approaches, not additional requirements; this structural draft does not claim any target has been achieved.

steps.phase: Read the frozen brief and surface assumptions
steps.title: Separate supplied targets from workload assumptions
steps.content: FACT — The brief names image, text, and audio annotation, 100+ concurrent annotators, Kappa above 0.8, 1M+ items, a sub-100ms annotation-interface target, and COCO/VOC export. ASSUMPTION / OPEN QUESTIONS — Ask about asset sizes and modalities, annotator skill mix and shift overlap, task duration, expected label density, acceptable adjudication delay, tenant isolation, retention, availability, and the exact latency percentile and measurement boundary. Do not invent traffic, storage, or accuracy targets; validate the stated thresholds with representative workloads.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add the annotator workspace
steps.content: Provide task instructions and modality-specific tools for image boxes, polygons, segmentation masks, text classification, NER, relation labeling, and audio annotation. Keep draft interaction state close to the annotator and submit compact annotation events through the service API.

component.label: Annotator Workspace
component.description: Browser UI for image, text, and audio labeling tasks.
component.highlightReason: The existing Web App catalog type represents the annotator-facing interface.

properties.purpose: Render image boxes, polygons and segmentation tools; text classification, NER and relation labeling; audio annotation; task instructions; and low-latency draft submission.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add the labeling API boundary
steps.content: Validate annotator identity, task ownership, annotation payloads, and idempotency keys before the request reaches workflow state. Avoid waiting for model training, bulk export, or adjudication analytics on the interface request path.

component.label: Labeling API
component.description: Validated entry point for task and annotation operations.
component.highlightReason: The catalog API Gateway provides an existing request-validation boundary.

properties.purpose: Authenticate annotators, validate task access and annotation payloads, and route bounded synchronous workspace requests.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add workflow and adjudication coordination
steps.content: Track task state, assignment leases, review state, consensus progress, gold questions, and adjudication decisions. Ensure expired or abandoned assignments can be safely returned to the eligible pool.

component.label: Workflow & Adjudication Service
component.description: Coordinates task lifecycle, assignment, consensus, and review.
component.highlightReason: The catalog backend type can own task state transitions and policy checks.

properties.purpose: Manage task assignment and leases, labeling stages, consensus thresholds, gold questions, and human adjudication records.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add a durable task queue
steps.content: Use queued task distribution to smooth bursty work and keep the assignment service from broadcasting every task to every annotator. Lease and retry behavior must prevent duplicate completed work from being counted twice.

component.label: Assignment Queue
component.description: Durable work distribution for eligible labeling tasks.
component.highlightReason: The existing Queue type represents asynchronous task assignment without adding a new catalog node.

properties.purpose: Buffer eligible tasks, support bounded retries and assignment leases, and absorb bursts from large datasets and concurrent annotators.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add the modality-aware labeling service
steps.content: Represent the labeling domain with the catalog Data Labeling component. It records structured outputs for image geometry, text labels and relations, and audio tasks while preserving task and annotator context for later quality analysis.

component.label: Annotation & Consensus Service
component.description: Stores typed annotations and coordinates agreement and adjudication.
component.highlightReason: The catalog's Data Labeling type directly models the platform's core domain.

properties.purpose: Persist image boxes, polygons and segmentation; text classification, NER and relations; and audio labels. Calculate inter-annotator agreement, collect model suggestions, form consensus sets, and route disagreements to adjudication.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add task and annotation metadata storage
steps.content: Persist task status, assignment ownership, annotation revisions, agreement inputs, adjudication outcomes, and references to immutable source assets. Store only the metadata needed for operational queries; keep large media objects out of the database row path.

component.label: Task & Annotation Metadata Store
component.description: Operational records for assignments, revisions, quality, and adjudication.
component.highlightReason: The existing Database type stores queryable workflow and annotation metadata.

properties.purpose: Store task and lease state, annotation revision metadata, annotator/task links, agreement aggregates, gold-question outcomes, and adjudication audit references.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add versioned source and export storage
steps.content: Keep large source media and immutable annotation dataset snapshots in object storage. Exports should be reproducible from a pinned annotation revision and include the requested COCO or VOC representation where applicable.

component.label: Media & Dataset Version Store
component.description: Durable source assets, annotation snapshots, and export artifacts.
component.highlightReason: The catalog Object Storage type separates large media and versioned exports from operational metadata.

properties.purpose: Store source images, text/audio payloads where appropriate, immutable annotation dataset revisions, and reproducible COCO/VOC export artifacts.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add versioned suggestion models
steps.content: Track the model version and task type used to produce each suggestion. Suggestions remain reviewable proposals; they must not silently become accepted labels or contaminate the gold set.

component.label: Suggestion Model Registry
component.description: Versioned pre-trained and task-specific models used for label suggestions.
component.highlightReason: The existing Model Registry type makes model and suggestion lineage visible.

properties.purpose: Pin model and taxonomy versions for pre-label suggestions, and retain the version reference with each proposed annotation.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add model-assisted suggestion inference
steps.content: Run selected assets through a suitable pre-trained model to produce candidate labels and uncertainty signals. Use active-learning ranking to prioritize review; keep the exact model, modality, and selection strategy as workload-dependent choices.

component.label: Suggestion Inference
component.description: Produces versioned candidate labels and uncertainty signals.
component.highlightReason: The catalog Model Serving type represents pre-label inference without adding a bespoke component.

properties.purpose: Generate candidate labels and uncertainty scores from the pinned suggestion model; return proposals for annotator review rather than accepting predictions as ground truth.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add the pipeline integration event stream
steps.content: Publish versioned dataset-ready, export-complete, and quality-status events for training pipeline integrations. Webhook delivery should be retried and deduplicated by event identity outside the annotator's synchronous request.

component.label: Dataset & Quality Event Stream
component.description: Asynchronous integration events for exports and downstream training.
component.highlightReason: The catalog Message Broker supports asynchronous webhooks and pipeline handoff.

properties.purpose: Publish versioned dataset-ready, export-complete, and quality-status events for idempotent webhook delivery and downstream ML pipeline consumption.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Connect accepted dataset revisions to training
steps.content: Downstream training consumes only a published dataset revision with its annotation schema and quality summary. Keep training execution outside the labeling interface's critical path.

component.label: Downstream ML Training
component.description: Consumes approved, versioned labeled datasets through pipeline events.
component.highlightReason: The catalog Model Training type represents the required downstream integration.

properties.purpose: Start or update training jobs from an approved dataset revision, preserving dataset, schema, and label-quality provenance.

steps.phase: Place the labeling workflow components
steps.title: Add throughput and quality visibility
steps.content: Track queue age, completion throughput, disagreement, gold-question performance, adjudication rate, and interface request latency. Report agreement by task type and annotator cohort so one aggregate does not hide a weak slice.

component.label: Label Quality & Throughput Monitoring
component.description: Operational metrics, agreement analysis, dashboards, and alert signals.
component.highlightReason: The existing Monitoring type covers quality and throughput observability.

properties.purpose: Report annotator concurrency, task throughput, queue age, agreement/Kappa by task type, gold-question outcomes, adjudication, and interface latency.

steps.phase: Make annotation and quality decisions explicit
steps.title: Use typed annotation schemas by task modality
steps.content: Represent image geometry, text spans/relations, and audio labels with versioned task schemas. Preserve original coordinates or offsets and validate them at submission. Schema details and supported audio formats are not specified in the brief and must be agreed with consumers.

decision.question: How should annotation payloads remain interpretable across modalities?
decision.chosen: Version a typed schema per task family and preserve source asset identity with each annotation revision.
decision.chosenReason: A generic untyped label field cannot express geometry, spans, relations, or task-specific validation consistently.

alternatives.option: Store every annotation as an opaque blob
alternatives.tradeoff: This weakens validation, comparison, and downstream export guarantees.

steps.phase: Make annotation and quality decisions explicit
steps.title: Keep agreement, consensus, and adjudication distinct
steps.content: Calculate agreement on comparable annotations, use the stated Kappa target as a measured quality gate, and send unresolved disagreement to an adjudicator. Gold questions provide a separate annotator-quality signal; they should not be mixed into production-label consensus.

decision.question: What happens when independent labels disagree?
decision.chosen: Retain the independent revisions, evaluate agreement, and route unresolved cases through consensus policy and explicit adjudication.
decision.chosenReason: Overwriting disagreements would erase the evidence required for agreement metrics and review.

alternatives.tradeoff: This loses independent evidence and cannot support consensus or reliable agreement analysis.

steps.phase: Make annotation and quality decisions explicit
steps.title: Use model suggestions to prioritize rather than replace labeling
steps.content: A candidate active-learning loop can rank items using uncertainty or coverage gaps, but the brief provides no model quality threshold or sampling policy. Evaluate selection bias and retain human review, especially for gold data and disputed classes.

decision.question: Should a model suggestion count as a completed annotation?
decision.chosen: No; model output is a versioned proposal that may prioritize a task and must remain distinguishable from a human-accepted label.
decision.chosenReason: The requirement asks for model-assisted suggestions, not automatic ground-truth substitution.

alternatives.tradeoff: This can amplify model errors and corrupt agreement and training labels.

steps.phase: Turn the supplied constraints into validation gates
steps.title: Validate concurrent annotator capacity
steps.content: Load-test simultaneous task fetches and submissions across representative annotator sessions; inspect queue age, database contention, and lease correctness.

scaleTrigger.action: Run concurrency and burst tests at and beyond the stated target, then scale stateless API/workflow capacity or partition assignment work based on measured bottlenecks.
scaleTrigger.impact: Protects assignment fairness and responsiveness without assuming a fixed per-annotator request rate.

steps.phase: Turn the supplied constraints into validation gates
steps.title: Validate the Kappa quality target
steps.content: Evaluate agreement on representative, adjudicated samples and report by modality, task type, and annotator cohort; confirm the chosen Kappa variant and sampling design.

scaleTrigger.action: Investigate low-agreement slices, instructions, taxonomy, and annotator calibration before releasing a dataset revision.
scaleTrigger.impact: Prevents a misleading aggregate from hiding unreliable labels.

steps.phase: Turn the supplied constraints into validation gates
steps.title: Validate dataset-size behavior
steps.content: Exercise task indexing, queue partitioning, asset reads, annotation revisions, and export generation at the stated dataset size; measure actual asset bytes and label density.

scaleTrigger.action: Partition or index hot work queues and export manifests based on observed access patterns, and test recovery and replay at target scale.
scaleTrigger.impact: Makes item count, rather than an assumed payload size, the explicit stated scale boundary.

steps.phase: Turn the supplied constraints into validation gates
steps.title: Measure annotation interface latency
steps.content: Measure user-visible task opening and annotation save at the agreed percentile, including browser rendering and service time. The exact percentile and timing boundaries are not specified by the brief.

scaleTrigger.action: Profile the full interaction path and keep bulk media transfer, model inference, export, and analytics asynchronous or prefetched where the product permits.
scaleTrigger.impact: Protects the stated interface objective without implying the entire asset download fits inside the target.

steps.phase: Turn the supplied constraints into validation gates
steps.title: Validate interoperable export contracts
steps.content: Round-trip representative supported image annotations through COCO and VOC exports and verify IDs, geometry, class mappings, and dataset revision references.

scaleTrigger.metric: Export labels in standard formats (COCO, VOC)
scaleTrigger.action: Version export schemas and run consumer compatibility fixtures before marking an export revision ready.
scaleTrigger.impact: Avoids silently publishing structurally valid but unusable training labels.

steps.phase: Review the structural draft
steps.title: Review the graph and evidence still needed
steps.content: The graph connects annotator interaction, validated assignment, typed human annotation, quality and adjudication records, immutable media/dataset versions, model-assisted proposals, pipeline events, and monitoring. FACTS are the exact frozen brief and its targets. ASSUMPTIONS include workload shape, latency percentile, identity and retention policy, task schemas, and active-learning selection. Structural tests can verify schema, catalog IDs/properties, replay, and anchor coverage; browser apply/save/reload and live assessment gates remain separate and have not been run for this draft.
